acceptance_stubs.user_intent: Apply clean dark theme (#121212 / #1a1a1a) with single electric blue (#3B82F6) accent, generous whitespace, zero decorative borders/gradients, and max 2 font weights.
acceptance_stubs.observable_outcome: Background renders #121212, card surfaces render #1a1a1a, active/focused elements use #3B82F6. No gradients or box-shadows on card elements. Fonts strictly 400 regular and 600 semibold.
acceptance_stubs.verification_method: Inspect DOM styles and CSS custom properties; assert color contrast meets WCAG AA (>= 4.5:1) and zero non-minimalist decorative styles.

acceptance_stubs.user_intent: Upload video via file browser or drag-and-drop into MediaPicker with clear uploaded state.
acceptance_stubs.observable_outcome: User selects or drops MP4/WebM video into dropzone; component transitions from 'idle' to 'uploaded' state; video attaches to ASCII render engine.
acceptance_stubs.verification_method: Drag and drop sample video file into dropzone; verify MediaPicker transitions to 'uploaded' and ASCII canvas renders video frame stream.

acceptance_stubs.user_intent: Access camera, start/stop live video recording, save/attach recorded clip to ASCII pipeline.
acceptance_stubs.observable_outcome: User clicks 'Open Live Camera', sees preview, clicks 'Start Recording' (shows recording state with pulsing red dot), clicks 'Stop Recording' (transitions to 'captured' state), attaches video.
acceptance_stubs.verification_method: Trigger recording loop in browser harness with mock or real media stream; assert valid blob and RecordingMetadata generated without errors.

acceptance_stubs.user_intent: Snap still photo from camera stream and send directly into ASCII canvas.
acceptance_stubs.observable_outcome: User clicks 'Capture Snapshot'; active camera frame is blitted to canvas; component transitions to 'captured' with snapshot preview; user confirms and frame converts to ASCII.
acceptance_stubs.verification_method: Trigger snapshot button during camera preview; assert SnapshotMetadata with valid dataUrl produced.

acceptance_stubs.user_intent: Configure camera/media permissions in Tauri desktop app (Info.plist on macOS, WebView2 events on Windows, WebKit on Linux).
acceptance_stubs.observable_outcome: tauri.conf.json contains capability mapping, Info.plist has NSCameraUsageDescription and NSMicrophoneUsageDescription, desktop build permits getUserMedia without unhandled crash.
acceptance_stubs.verification_method: Verify presence and schema compliance of Info.plist, tauri.conf.json, and Tauri permissions.

acceptance_stubs.user_intent: System defends gracefully against permission denial, unsupported MIME types, 4K OOM, and Tauri webview locks.
acceptance_stubs.observable_outcome: All 4 breaking scenarios (STRESS-CAM-01, STRESS-REC-02, STRESS-MEM-03, STRESS-TAURI-04) trigger defensive handlers and friendly user copy without crashing.
acceptance_stubs.verification_method: Run automated unit and integration tests executing stress vectors; verify failure thresholds survived.
